'''Ewa Maria Bartnik''', née Balicka (born December 15, 1949, in [[Warsaw]]) is a [[Polish people|Polish]] [[Biology|biologist]], Professor of [[List of life sciences|Biological Sciences]], [[university lecturer]] and [[Popular science|populariser of science]].

She initially studied Biology at the [[University of Warsaw]].<ref name="biznes">{{Cite web |title=Wykładowcy: Profesor Ewa Bartnik |url=http://www.biznes.org.pl/pl/wykladowcy |website=biznes.org.pl|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120812052304/http://www.biznes.org.pl/pl/wykladowcy |archive-date=2012-08-12 |language=pl}}</ref> subsequently obtaining her [[PhD]] and [[habilitation]]. In 1993 she was appointed Professor of Biological Sciences.<ref name="ln">{{Polish scientists|27623}}</ref> She began her professional career at the Department of Genetics of the University of Warsaw,<ref name="biznes" /> later working at the Institute of Genetics and Biotechnology and at the Institute of Biochemistry and Biophysics of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="ln" /> Her research has dealt with issues in [[molecular biology]] and [[genetics]], including studies of [[mitochondrial DNA]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ludzki genom mitochondrialny – mutacje, polimorfizmy i choroby |url=http://www.pan-ol.lublin.pl/biul_4/art_404.htm |website=pan-ol.lublin.pl|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190204014929/http://www.pan-ol.lublin.pl/biul_4/art_404.htm |archive-date=2019-02-04 |language=pl}}</ref> She served as Secretary General of the Polish Genetic Society, became Deputy Chair of the Committee of Human Genetics and Molecular Pathology of the Polish Academy of Sciences and was a member of the Central Commission for Degrees and Titles.<ref name="ln" /> She has co-authored biology textbooks for secondary schools and academic textbooks, and she was Poland's representative in the Life Sciences expert group of the Programme for International Student Assessment ([[Programme for International Student Assessment|PISA]]).

Ewa Maria Bartnik is also a populariser of science. In 2008 she was presented with an honorary award for media-friendly scientists by the Polish Association of Science Journalists.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2008-10-16 |title=Nagroda im. Karola Sabatha wręczona |url=http://www.naukowi.pl/?p=854 |website=naukowi.pl |language=pl |access-date=2023-11-09 |archive-date=2013-05-03 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130503235527/http://www.naukowi.pl/?p=854 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In 2012 President [[Bronisław Komorowski]] awarded Ewa Maria Bartnik the Knight's Cross of the [[Order of Polonia Restituta]] ''for her outstanding achievements in scientific research, her teaching activities, her contribution to science in Poland and around the world, and her support of international scientific cooperation.''<ref>{{Cite web |date=2012-10-03 |title=Odznaczenia i nominacje profesorskie |url=http://www.prezydent.pl/aktualnosci/ordery-i-odznaczenia/art,1145,odznaczenia-i-nominacje-profesorskie.html |website=prezydent.pl |language=pl |access-date=2023-11-09 |archive-date=2012-12-09 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20121209114239/http://www.prezydent.pl/aktualnosci/ordery-i-odznaczenia/art,1145,odznaczenia-i-nominacje-profesorskie.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>
